name: Recession
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign hand over creation and history, as seen in the completion of the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1; 2:1). Even amid trials and challenges, such as those foreshadowed in Isaiah's vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem (Isaiah 1:1), believers are called to trust in the Lord as their rock and salvation (Psalms 95:1). The promise of wise and exalted leadership who will prosper God's purposes (Isaiah 52:13) encourages steadfast faith, while the apostle Paul's concern for believers' spiritual well-being amid conflict (Colossians 2:1) reminds us to rely on Christ-centered care during times of economic uncertainty and recession.
